subject: MAP: success-signal ledger & verification run
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@acmehealth.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@verisys.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: success-signal ledger & verification run

Elena / Sanjay — attaching a compact MAP draft and a proposed verification run for the evaluation period. High level asks below, followed by the signal ledger (short) and minimal test cases we think prove out production readiness.

Quick ask: can you review the success signals and tell us which three are mandatory for your clinical signoff? We'll freeze the MAP once we have those.

Highlights (TL;DR)
- Evaluation window: 3 weeks (pilot cadence: 2w active, 1w scale validation)
- Primary success signals: inference latency P95 <= 220ms, prompt-to-concordance >= 92% on the curated test suite, false positive rate on PHI redaction <= 0.5%
- Exit decision: go/no-go at scale-validation week based on the verification run matrix (see attached MAP_signal_ledger_v1.xlsx)

Signal ledger (short):
1) Latency: P95 per-route (inference only) target 220ms — measurement: 95th percentile over 1-hour rolling windows during burst tests.
2) Cost envelope: infra tokens cost < $X per 1k gen tokens — measurement: billing sample plus trace token counts.
3) Quality concordance: measured against 1k blind prompts (internal test set) — target 92% match to human label.
4) Privacy/PII redaction: automated redaction must not leak structured PHI — target FP <= 0.5% on blue-team probe set.
5) Regression leash: fallbacks must activate within 200ms of detection and switch to smaller model with human-in-the-loop flag.

Suggested verification run (minimum tests):
- Smoke harness: 50 concurrent users at target prompt mix for 30m (verify latency, error rate < 1%).
- Concordance sweep: 1k prompts across diagnosis synonyms and abbreviations.
- PHI probe: 200 seeded prompts with synthetic PHI variants.
- Failover exercise: simulated node outage and model fallback validation.

Attachments: MAP_signal_ledger_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), verification-scenarios.md (plain text steps).

Next steps: please mark the top-3 signals you require for signoff and any additional compliance checks by Friday EOD PT. I'll update the MAP and circulate a signed mutual action plan.

Thanks,
Mateo
Sr. Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Torres <elena@acmehealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@verisys.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: success-signal ledger & verification run

Thanks Mateo — quick clarifications from AcmeHealth clinical ops:
- PHI redaction target is critical, we need clarity on the exact probe set you used. Can you provide the test vectors or allow us to run our own?
- For latency: 220ms P95 is ambitious in our region; we want a P95 <= 300ms for initial pilot, and a plan to reach 220ms during scale validation.
- Concordance: 92% is reasonable, but can we add a separate patient-safety bucket to require 98% for high-risk prompt classes?

Also, procurement asked for an explicit canary checklist (what counts as a canary failure, who is paged). Can you add that to the verification doc?

Elena
Product Lead, Clinical Integrations
AcmeHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena@acmehealth.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@verisys.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: success-signal ledger & verification run

On Wed, 12 Aug 2026 at 08:40, Elena Torres <elena@acmehealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Mateo — quick clarifications from AcmeHealth clinical ops: ...

Elena / team — copying the internal ops checklist we'll use to make the canary deterministic. Adding these items to verification-scenarios.md and attaching a canary matrix to the MAP spreadsheet:

Canary checklist (proposal):
- Canary window: 2h with amplified traffic and synthetic golden prompts.
- Failure thresholds that trigger rollback:
  * error rate > 1.5% sustained for 10m
  * P95 latency > 350ms for 10m
  * PHI probe FP > 1.0% on blue-team set
- Pager path: SRE on-call -> Mateo (solutions) -> Marissa (CS lead) -> Elena (customer PM)
- Post-mortem cadence: 48h initial RCA, 7-day detailed report if customer impact observed.

Acceptance tests (explicit cases we will run):
- AT-01 (smoke): 50 concurrent synthetic users, verify error rate < 1% and P95 < 300ms (pilot target).
- AT-02 (concordance): 1k mixed prompts, compute top-1 label concordance and patient-safety bucket metrics.
- AT-03 (privacy): PHI probe of 200 variations; no structured PHI should be returned.
- AT-04 (fallback): kill one model node, validate automatic fallback within 200ms and the request completes with no silent data loss.

I also recommend we add acceptance criteria pass/fail fields and who signs each (Acme ops + Redwood SRE). I'll update the doc and ping legal for the MAP signature block.

Marissa
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@verisys.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: MAP: success-signal ledger & verification run

Elena — updated based on your asks and Marissa's canary checklist. Changes:
- Latency: pilot acceptance uses P95 <= 300ms; scale-validation target remains P95 <= 220ms.
- Patient-safety bucket: added high-risk class with 98% concordance requirement (AT-02a).
- PHI probe: attached the seeded vectors and methodology in verification-scenarios.md for Acme to run locally (see attachment).
- Canary: added explicit failure/retry policy and pager steps.

Final request: please confirm the mandatory top-3 signals you need for clinical signoff: (1) PHI redaction, (2) high-risk concordance, (3) stability during canary. If we get confirmation, I'll mark the MAP as agreed and loop legal for signatures.

Next steps once you confirm:
- 48h scheduling window for the smoke harness with Redwood SRE.
- Delivery of final MAP + DocuSign link.

Thanks everyone — attaching MAP_signal_ledger_v1.xlsx and verification-scenarios.md.

Mateo
Sr. Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
